title: Optimize Suggestions: add risk scoring pipeline stub + UI explanation fields
author: Yara Haddad
release_notes: Internal-only: adds risk_level + rationale/assumptions fields to suggestions payload (stubbed computation). No user-visible behavior change unless suggestions beta is enabled.
body:
Summary: This PR adds an initial (stub) risk scoring pipeline for Optimize Suggestions and wires the results into the suggestions payload as explanation-friendly fields for the Console detail drawer. The goal is to unblock UI work and schema stabilization while Applied ML calibrates the actual model/thresholds. Risk is currently computed via a conservative heuristic and is explicitly marked as v0. 

Context / Why: Console Suggestions beta needs a standardized way to display a risk label (low/medium/high) along with short rationale bullets and assumptions so customers understand why a suggestion is safe (or not) to apply. This PR implements the data shape and a pipeline hook point so we can iterate on scoring without reworking the Console contract. This is tracked in ENG-2405 and references ADR-0274 (risk taxonomy). 

What changed: Adds a risk scoring module invoked during suggestion materialization. Introduces a versioned RiskExplanation attached to each suggestion record (and returned by the API) including: risk_level (LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH), risk_score (0-1 float), risk_score_version (e.g. "v0"), rationale_bullets (short, user-facing strings), assumptions (short strings), and inputs_used (internal/debug list of feature keys; not shown in UI by default). Provides a conservative default policy: if required telemetry is missing/too stale, set risk_level=HIGH with rationale indicating missing data. If latency headroom < threshold or workload variance flagged, set MEDIUM/HIGH accordingly. Adds unit tests for mapping logic and payload serialization, plus basic golden tests for example suggestions. 

Important notes / limitations: This is intentionally not the final calibration. The numeric score is not yet meaningful beyond ordering/debug; the primary surface is risk_level + rationale. The rationale strings are written to be safe (no overpromising) and are designed to align with Console copy guidelines ("estimated", "based on last 7 days"). We do not persist or expose raw tenant metrics in the explanation; we only expose derived/bucketed signals (e.g., "latency headroom: low") to reduce leakage of sensitive usage patterns. 

API/Schema: suggestion.risk: { risk_level, risk_score, risk_score_version, rationale_bullets[], assumptions[] }. This mirrors the draft console contract and is backwards-compatible (field is optional; older suggestions will omit it). 

Testing: Added unit tests for (1) missing telemetry -> HIGH risk, (2) sufficient headroom + stable workload -> LOW risk, (3) conflicting signals -> MEDIUM risk, (4) serialization across BFF boundary. Ran: bazel test //optimize/suggestions/... and //console/bff/... 

Rollout: No behavior change unless Suggestions beta is enabled. Risk scoring is gated behind the existing suggestions pipeline flag and can be disabled server-side by setting RISK_SCORING_ENABLED=false. 

Follow-ups: (a) replace v0 heuristics with calibrated model + thresholds (Applied ML), (b) add offline evaluation + calibration notebook outputs to ADR appendix, (c) add telemetry freshness SLO enforcement (ENG-2403 dependency), (d) confirm UI copy for rationale bullets with Design (DES-188).
commits: optimize/suggestions: add RiskExplanation model + serialization helpers
optimize/suggestions: implement v0 risk scoring heuristic + version tag
optimize/suggestions: attach risk explanation to suggestion materialization path
console/bff: plumb risk fields through suggestions endpoints
tests: add unit coverage + golden payload fixtures
review_conversation:
Jonas Weber: Can we make it explicit in the payload that this is v0 / heuristic and not "model-calibrated"? Also recommend we keep the rationale bullets short and stable because customers will screenshot them. Yara Haddad: Added risk_score_version="v0" and updated rationale strings to be stable templates; also added a comment in code to treat these as UI-facing copy. 

Selene Huang: For missing telemetry, HIGH makes sense, but we should avoid wording that implies the suggestion is wrong—just that we can’t assess risk. Can we tweak the bullet to "Insufficient telemetry to estimate latency/quality impact"? Yara Haddad: Updated missing telemetry rationale bullets and assumptions accordingly; added a unit test for the exact string template. 

Jordan Lee: Please confirm we are not including any raw cost/token counts in the risk object. Also, add a guard so inputs_used is not returned to non-internal callers. Yara Haddad: Removed any numeric/raw metrics from the risk explanation; inputs_used is now behind INTERNAL_DEBUG_FIELDS feature flag and default-off. 

Chloe Martin: Console BFF should tolerate absence of risk fields (older records). Can you ensure the JSON schema marks risk as optional and we don’t break rendering? Yara Haddad: Made risk optional end-to-end and added a fixture test for missing risk object.
